title: Spatio-Temporal Manipulation of Small GTPase Activity at Subcellular Level and on Timescale of Seconds in Living Cells
protocol: Transfect plasmid DNAs into cells.
Add 0.5 µg membrane-tethered FRB and 0.5 µg FKBP-Tiam1 tagged with fluorescent protein to 37.5 μl dH2O.
Add 1 μl FuGENE HD.
Vortex the mixture.
Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Wash each well of an 8-well chamber with 50 µl poly-D-Lysine.
Wash the center of each well with dH2O.
Trypsinize 80-85% confluent NIH-3T3 cells.
Dilute trypsinized cells to 10 ml culture medium (DMEM with 10% FBS).
Remove 375 µl of cell suspension and centrifuge at 1750 rpm for 3 minutes.
Aspirate the media, being careful not to disturb the pellet.
Add 750 µl of DMEM with 10% FBS and resuspend cells.
Combine cell suspension with dH2O/DNA/FuGENE HD solution and mix gently.
Add 250 μl of cell/DNA suspension to each well (fills up to 3 wells).
Incubate the transfected cells at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 15-18 hours.
Synthesize caged rapamycin-biotin adduct (cRb).
Prepare a 1 μM stock solution of cRb in DMSO.
Dissolve 1 mg avidin in 250 µl of PBS in a 0.5 ml Eppendorf tube.
Add 1 μl of cRb stock solution to dissolved avidin.
Mix by inverting the tube several times.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 min to yield cRb-avidin conjugate (cRb-A) solution.
Exclude unbound small molecules and purify cRb-A using a size-exclusion column.
Serum starve transfected cells in DMEM without FBS for 12 hours.
Gently aspirate the media off the cells.
Add 250 μl of the prepared 400 nM cRb-A solution to the cells.
Use spinning disk microscopy to visualize protein dynamics in living cells at subcellular resolution before and after light treatment.
Achieve UV illumination by coupling optics for UV LED light (365 nm) with epi-fluorescence light.
Define the coordinates and size of an illumination spot using a glass plate coated with fluorescent dyes excited by UV light.
Irradiate UV light at the periphery of cells after determining background levels of membrane ruffling.
Globally irradiate cells with 365 nm light provided by a mercury lamp.
Dissolve uncaged rapamycin in DMSO and then in PBS (400 nM final).
Add the solution to the imaging chamber to induce global effects.
